title: Derivative of the Gaussian density quotient
statement: For every nonzero $x\in\mathbb R$, the function $y\mapsto \phi(y)/y$, where $\phi$ is the standard Gaussian density, is differentiable at $x$ with derivative $-\phi(x)-\phi(x)/x^2$.
